text.body: laghumādhyandinīya śikṣā atha śikṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi mādhyandinamatam̐yyathā ṣakārasya khakāraḥ syāṭṭukayoge tu no bhavet 1 iṣe lakṣyaṃ kṛṣṇa'ukṣā samudraḥ pratyudāhṛtiḥ padādau vidyamānasya hyasam̐yuktasya yasya ca 2 ādeśo hi jakāraḥ syādyuktaḥ sanharaṇena tu yajñena yajñaṃ vailakṣyaṃ mayūre pratyudāhṛtiḥ 3 tasmādyajjñāttsarvvahutaḥ samasmmādyattathaiva ca repheṇātha hakāreṇa yuktasya sarvathā bhavet 4 sūryo bāhyantu vailakṣyaṃ śaṣpyyāya pratyudāhṛtiḥ yakārarkārayuktasya jakāraḥ sarvathā bhavet 5 saharayyā tathā vyṛddhyā copasargaparasya na upayajñammānuṣāṇāmapi yantītyudāhṛtiḥ 6 gururvakāro vijñeyaḥ padādau paṭhito bhavet vibhrāḍudāhṛtirjñeyā savitāntarlaghuḥ smṛtaḥ 7 padānte vai laghutarastava vvāyavṛtaspate upasargaparo yastu savakāro laghurmataḥ 8 vo vāṃ vā vai mantrapāṭhe laghavo guravaḥ pade pravāyumacchā bṛhatī vāto veti nidarśanam 9 repho rephatvamāpnoti śaṣaheṣu pareṣu ca dadarśa varṣo arhācca saṃyyoge naiva kārayet 10 vvarṣmmanvarṣyāyāntarhṛdā tatra tāvadudāhṛtiḥ lakāro'pi ca sāvarṇyādekārasadṛśo bhavet 11 śatabalśā ca balhā ca tatra tāvadudāhṛtiḥ anusvāro yatra kutra rṭha0kāro bhavati dhruvam 12 hrasvo dīrgho guruśceti trividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ hrasvātparo bhaveddīrgho harṭha0sa'iti darśanam 13 dīrghātparo bhaveddhrasvo māṃsebhya'iti darśanam gurau pare hyanusvāro gurureva hi sa smṛtaḥ 14 siṃhyasīti tatra tāvadṛkāre dīrgha'eva saḥ devānāṃ hṛdaye tadvattaskarāṇāṃ tathā sṛke 15 athāyogavāhānāha– avarṇācca ṛkārācca visargaḥ kaṇṭhya eva saḥ ivarṇācca tathovarṇāttathā caikārapūrvakaḥ 16 aukārapūrvakaścaiva tālavyo bhavati dhruvam ekārācca kaṇṭhatālurvisargo bhavati dhruvam 17 kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyastu tathaukārād visargo bhavati dhruvam devo vaḥ savitā cātra hakārasadṛśo bhavet 18 devīstisro visargastu hikārasadṛśo bhavet ākhuste paśurityādau hakārasadṛśo bhavet 19 visargaścāgnerityādau hekārasadṛśo bhavet visargo bāhvorityādau hokārasadṛśo bhavet 20 atha svairdṛkṣairityādau hikārasadṛśo bhavet visargo dyauṣpitetyādau hakārasadṛśo bhavet 21 hakāro naiva mantavya iti śāstravyavasthitiḥ phaṇiniśvāsasadṛśo visargo bhavati dhruvam 22 kaniṣṭhikāmocanaṃ tu nīce ca pracaye sati namaḥ kūpyāya prathamo dvitīyo jāgratastathā 23 tarjanīmocanaṃ kuryādudātte tu visargake devo dharmastathā hrasve svarite tūbhayaṃ kṣipet 24 aśvo martyo bhavellakṣyaṃ svāre dīrghe kaniṣṭhikām ubhayorapi hrasve ca vakāre svarite sati 25 dīrghe'pi cobhayoḥ kṣepa'iti śāstravyavasthitiḥ yathā sphaṭikadaṇḍādirupādhivaśato bhavet 26 tadvadūṣmā prayoktavyo hihuheho nidarśanam vvasoḥ pavitraṃ vai tatra hyudāharaṇamucyate 27 ṛkāraḥ khalu sarvatra hyekārasadṛśo bhavet hṛde mṛgastṛtīyā ca ṛcaṃ vvācamathāparam 28 iti laghumādhyandinīyā śikṣā samāptā
